title: I love you Lord By Si

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, You mean to me more than everything,
No word can quantify You for anything.
Lord You magnificently reign in me,
Oh Lord, I just wanna love You more…

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: I just love to love You Lord

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You’re the greatest love of all

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: I just love to love You Lord, I love You
I just love to praise You Jesus, I praise You
I just love to love You

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: I just love to love You Lord
